scope: Independent read-only audit of the landed demo and visual contract. No source, registry, lesson, or course file was edited; this report is the only authored file.
sources_read: course.yaml repaired demo spec, lesson guided Task, demo-preflight.json, weak-tone-study.mjs, landed demo and all landed figure sources

blockers.evidence: Fresh Next 16.2.11 dev loads repeatedly emit React hydration mismatch warnings for both Slider inputs: server DOM contains style accent-color:var(--accent),caret-color:transparent while the client expects only accentColor:var(--accent). The Next dev indicator shows 1 Issue. Repeated renderToString equality alone therefore does not establish clean hydration.

The frozen visual contract requires a labeled q=[25.5,26.5] bracket, local-leakage level, and observed-neighborhood peak. The demo draws only an unlabeled gray band and the two traces: it has no plotted leakage-level or peak marker. At 312/360 px the nine SVG labels render at approximately 6/8 CSS px, so axes and trace identities are not readable on a phone.

On the actual lesson route, WindowCalibrationLedger has scrollWidth 565 px inside 264/312 px figures and WindowTradeoffMap has scrollWidth 619 px inside 264/312 px figures. Their fixed min-width grids force horizontal page overflow at both audited viewports.

Measured minimum rendered SVG text heights at viewport 312/360 px are: periodic sequence 5/6 px, WindowShapeSpectrumPair 6/7 px, weak-tone-masking 5/6 px, demo 6/8 px, WindowTradeoffMap 4/5 px. Essential labels therefore fail the readable-phone requirement even where the figure itself does not overflow.
blockers.affected: Four of five lesson figures plus the demo plot

contract_mismatches: The metric card labels a negative response value as scalloping (-3.92 dB), while the lesson defines scalloping loss with a leading minus sign and reports it as positive 3.92 dB.
The main-lobe card says only 'bins' although the contract requires current-record-bin units and the same panel prominently uses original-bin q coordinates.

WindowCalibrationLedger alt text says corrected amplitude is one, while the rendered formula leaves it as symbolic A; WindowTradeoffMap alt calls the card strip a table. Other alt/caption claims match the rendered data.
